ASHWATER.description: exhaust any number of cards in your hand.
ASHWATER.name: Ashwater
ASHWATER.zh_description: 消耗手牌中任意数量的卡牌。

ATTACK_POTION.description: choose 1 of 3 distinct Attack cards generated from your character card pool (may skip); the card is added to hand and is free this turn. run-53 live 2026-09-19: opens card_choice (choose 1 of 3 generated Attacks, may skip); picked card is added free-this-turn. Live offer BODY_SLAM/THRASH/WHIRLWIND; Whirlwind pick at energy 4 was the lethal-turn survival instrument (32 AoE wipe).
ATTACK_POTION.name: Attack Potion
ATTACK_POTION.zh_description: 从角色卡池生成 3 张不同攻击牌中选 1 张（可跳过）；加入手牌，本回合免费。

BEETLE_JUICE.description: Beetle Juice - Potion - Slay the Spire 2 (sts2) | Spire Codex ← Back to Potions ◆ Rare · shared · Potion Beetle Juice Enemy's attacks deal 30% less damage for the next 4 turns. On this page Community Description Relations Synergy Version history Community performance Live aggregate across community-submitted runs. BEETLE_JUICE.name: BEETLE_JUICE

BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.description: Upgrade every upgradable card in your hand for THIS combat (Armaments-class, reverts after). Spend on highest hand-density / lethal-intent turns. Live run-43 Act2 (4,0): 5-card attack hand upgraded IronWave+2/+2, TwinStrike+2, Pommel+1/draw2, Strike+3 - used on a 19-intent POUNCE turn. Also the RANSACK event rare-potion roll run-43 (claimed properly - run-42 had skipped the claim screen).
BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.name: Blessing of the Forge
BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.zh_description: 为本场战斗升级手牌中所有可升级卡（战斗内限定——战斗后还原，Armaments 同类）。run-38 实时：致命意图 Boss 回合确认 Defend 5→8（8+8=16 挡对 17 来袭）；熔岩拳 10→14 同理。在手牌密度最高/来袭致命的回合使用——不是永久牌库投资。

BLOCK_POTION.description: Gain 12 Block on use. Uncommon-class reserve potion for lethal-intent turns and boss gates. LIVE run-40: consumed Decimillipede T4 — 12 + Evil Eye 16 (Unmovable-doubled) = 28 vs 32 incoming at 34 HP. Potion-sourced block does NOT double with Unmovable (card-block only).
BLOCK_POTION.name: Block Potion
BLOCK_POTION.source: md:potions.md:L18; md:potions_zh.md:L18; codex:potions/BLOCK_POTION; run-40 live fold 2026-09-18

BLOOD_POTION.description: Heal 20% of Max HP (run-49 live: 80 Max → +16). Usable anytime.
BLOOD_POTION.name: Blood Potion
BLOOD_POTION.play_notes: Run-49 live: drank mid-Entomancer at HP 23→39 (20% of 80 = 16). Corridor sustain class — spend BEFORE the lethal turn, not after.

BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.description: move your hand into the draw pile, shuffle the draw pile, draw 5.
BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.name: Bottled Potential
BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.zh_description: 将手牌移入抽牌堆，洗牌，抽 5 张。

CLARITY.description: draw 1; apply ClarityPower 3 — draw +1 card at the start of each of your next 3 turns (decrements at your turn start).
CLARITY.name: Clarity Extract
CLARITY.zh_description: 抽 1 张；获得 ClarityPower 3——接下来 3 回合开始时各多抽 1 张（每次己方回合开始递减）。

COLORLESS_POTION.description: choose 1 of 3 distinct Colorless-pool cards (may skip); add to hand, free this turn.
COLORLESS_POTION.name: Colorless Potion
COLORLESS_POTION.zh_description: 从无色卡池生成 3 张不同卡牌中选 1 张（可跳过）；加入手牌，本回合免费。

COSMIC_CONCOCTION.description: add 3 distinct upgraded Colorless-pool cards to hand.
COSMIC_CONCOCTION.name: Cosmic Concoction
COSMIC_CONCOCTION.zh_description: 向手牌加入 3 张不同的升级版无色池卡牌。

CUNNING_POTION.name: Cunning Potion
CUNNING_POTION.zh_description: 向手牌加入 3 张升级版 Shiv。

CURE_ALL.description: Cures debuff-class afflictions on the player. **Does NOT cure Power-class taxes** — live run-52 reconfirmed: poured on RINGING_POWER at Act1 boss T8 with zero effect (wasted); run-51's original correction held. Check the target tax id: `_POWER` suffix ⇒ expect no cure.
CURE_ALL.name: Cure All
CURE_ALL.zh_description: 解除玩家身上减益类异常。**不解 Power 类税**——live run-52 再确认：Act1 Boss T8 对 RINGING_POWER 使用零效果（浪费）；run-51 的原始订正成立。检查目标税 id：`_POWER` 后缀 ⇒ 预期无效。

DEXTERITY_POTION.description: Gain 2 Dexterity for the combat (card-block +2, stacks with OddlySmoothStone). Live run-43: Dex1+2=3 total; Defend 6+3=9, TrueGrit 8+3=11, UltimateDefend 13+3=16 - 16>=15 solo-stunned BowlbugRock HEADBUTT. Bowlbug doctrine note run-39: Dex+Defend x2=14 was one short of 15 - always compute the live total vs the intent number before concluding stun is impossible.
DEXTERITY_POTION.name: Dexterity Potion

DISTILLED_CHAOS.description: Play the top 3 cards of your Draw Pile. Variance-class - cost/targets uncontrolled. Shop (5,0) Act2 live price 102g run-43 (not bought).
DISTILLED_CHAOS.name: Distilled Chaos
DISTILLED_CHAOS.zh_description: 打出抽牌堆顶的 3 张牌。

DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.description: choose 1 card from your draw pile; add it to hand.
DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.name: Droplet of Precognition
DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.zh_description: 从抽牌堆选 1 张牌加入手牌。

DUPLICATOR.description: Apply DuplicationPower 1 — the next card you play this combat is played 1 extra time; removed at end of turn. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): Pommel Strike 9 resolved twice (18) on a kill turn; potions are NOT cards for RINGING-class counters (run-48 rule held).
DUPLICATOR.name: Duplicator
DUPLICATOR.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: Duplicator+Uppercut 48 dmg under RINGING — potion-not-card rule live. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]
DUPLICATOR.zh_description: 获得 DuplicationPower 1——本回合你打出的下一张牌额外打出 1 次；回合结束移除。使用后 DUPLICATION_POWER:1 同帧可见，下一张攻击双结算（如 Bash+ 双结算）；药水消费后 DuplicationPower 随回合结束消失。

ENTROPIC_BREW.description: fill every empty potion slot with a random potion.
ENTROPIC_BREW.name: Entropic Brew
ENTROPIC_BREW.zh_description: 用随机药水填满所有空药水栏。

ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.description: channel 1 Dark orb per orb slot you have.
ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.name: Essence of Darkness
ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.zh_description: 每个充能球槽引导 1 个暗球。

EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.description: deal 10 damage to ALL enemies (automatic multi-target; do not send a target id).
EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.name: Explosive Ampoule
EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.zh_description: 对全体敌人造成 10 点伤害（自动多目标，不要发送目标 id）。

FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: On lethal damage, revive at 30% of Max HP (live run-52: 24/80 from a Crimson Mantle tick death mid-combat) and the potion is consumed. Proc fires from ANY lethal source including unblockable self-damage ticks — not only enemy attacks. Boss-corridor reserve value: once spent in a hall fight the endgame has no revive buffer (run-52 lesson).
FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Fairy in a Bottle
FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.zh_description: 受到致死伤害时以 30% Max HP 复活（live run-52：战斗中被深红斗篷税致死时 24/80）并消耗药水。任意致死来源均可触发——包括不可格挡自伤税，不限敌方攻击。Boss 走廊储备价值：一旦在走廊战消耗，终局即无复活缓冲（run-52 教训）。

FIRE_POTION.description: Deal 20 damage — typeless: NOT amplified by Vulnerable or SLOW stacks. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): exact 20 on Marbles-Vuln'd Insatiable confirmed; do not count potion damage in Vuln/Slow window math.
FIRE_POTION.name: Fire Potion
FIRE_POTION.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: flat 20 under Vuln2+Slow display — un-amped confirmed. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]

FLEX_POTION.description: Gain +5 Strength for this turn only (temporary; expires end of turn).
FLEX_POTION.name: Flex Potion
FLEX_POTION.play_notes: Run-49 live: STR +5 applied same turn (powers showed STRENGTH_POWER + FLEX_POTION_POWER :5); Setup Strike's post-hit +3 stacked on top to 11 before expiry; both temp sources decremented end of turn (11→3 base Inflame held).
FLEX_POTION.zh_description: 获得 FlexPotionPower +5 力量——本回合结束时失去 5 力量（临时力量）。

FORTIFIER.description: gain Block equal to 2× your current Block (your Block becomes 3×).
FORTIFIER.name: Fortifier
FORTIFIER.zh_description: 获得等同当前格挡 2 倍的格挡（格挡变为 3 倍）。

FOUL_POTION.description: In combat: deal 12 damage to EVERY non-pet creature INCLUDING you (AoE 12 + self 12; suicide-class below ~15 HP; self-damage triggers Rupture). In a Merchant room: gain 100 Gold. In FakeMerchant event it starts the fight - never use there. POTION_COURIER event offers x3 (run-42 declined at 13 HP; run-43 at 44 HP still declined - bridge rejects use_potion outside combat, so the merchant-gold line is not agent-reachable yet).
FOUL_POTION.name: Foul Potion
FOUL_POTION.zh_description: 战斗中——对每个非宠物生物（含你自己）造成 12 点伤害；商人房间——获得 100 金币；FakeMerchant 事件——触发伪商人战斗。战斗用法=同窗 AoE 工具——12 伤可直接带走 12 HP 千足虫段并铺垫 Thunderclap 收头；自伤触发 Rupture（按 Amount +力）。伪商人房绝不可用（战斗条款）——留给真商人房 +100 金是经济线。

FYSH_OIL.description: +1 Strength and +1 Dexterity for the combat. STRENGTH_POWER +1 and DEXTERITY_POWER:1 appear same state read on use; Dex +1 raises subsequent card-block values by 1 each (Defend 5→6 class) same combat. Usage-timing variant attested: a later decode lists Fysh Oil as anytime/self with the same immediate +1/+1 — verify timing per build. run-53 live 2026-09-19: +1 Str +1 Dex for the combat — held as boss-reserve this run, not spent in hall fights.
FYSH_OIL.name: Fysh Oil
FYSH_OIL.zh_description: 本场战斗 +1 力量 +1 敏捷。使用后同帧 STRENGTH_POWER +1 与 DEXTERITY_POWER:1；敏捷 +1 使后续卡牌挡值各 +1（Defend 5→6 级）同战生效。使用时机存在异文：另有解码记为「随时/自身」、同样立刻 +1/+1——按 build 核实时机。

GAMBLER_S_BREW.description: discard any number of hand cards, then draw that many.
GAMBLER_S_BREW.name: Gambler's Brew
GAMBLER_S_BREW.zh_description: 弃置任意数量手牌，然后抽取等量牌。

GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.description: Apply GigantificationPower 1 — your next powered Attack card this combat deals x3 damage; consumed by that attack. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): Thunderclap-Vuln + player Weak + Gigantified Stomp resolved ~40 AoE (12 x3 x0.75 x1.5) — swept a 46/42/22 bowlbug trio in one Stomp; stacks multiplicatively with Weak x0.75 and Vuln x1.5 (run-42 formula reconfirmed).
GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.name: Gigantification Potion
GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.zh_description: 获得 GigantificationPower 1——本场战斗你打出的下一张有源攻击牌造成 ×3 伤害；被该次攻击消耗。

LIQUID_MEMORIES.description: choose 1 card from your discard pile; add it to hand and it is free this turn. Unusable when the discard pile is empty — played with an empty discard the potion is consumed with NO card_choice and no effect (total whiff). Check piles before use.
LIQUID_MEMORIES.name: Liquid Memories
LIQUID_MEMORIES.zh_description: 从弃牌堆选 1 张牌加入手牌，本回合免费。弃牌堆为空时不可用——空弃牌堆打出时药水被消耗但**无选牌界面、无任何效果**（完全空耗）。使用前先确认 piles。

OROBIC_ACID.description: add 1 random Attack, 1 random Skill, 1 random Power from your character card pool to hand; all 3 are free this turn. LIVE run-48 Spiny Toad EXPLOSION turn: generated PACTS_END (0c 17 AoE gated on exhaust>=3 — whiffed at exhaust 0, thorns-risk if played) + EXPECT_A_FIGHT (2c skill, +1e per attack in hand, NO_ENERGY_GAIN lock) + free CRUELTY copy — ZERO block-class skill rolled on a 23-dmg block-gate turn. Do not count Orobic Acid as block insurance; it is variance fuel.
OROBIC_ACID.name: Orobic Acid
OROBIC_ACID.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: whiffed on block need at EXPLOSION gate — variance fuel not insurance. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]
OROBIC_ACID.zh_description: 从角色卡池随机攻击、技能、能力牌各 1 张加入手牌；3 张本回合均免费。

POTION_OF_BINDING.description: apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
POTION_OF_BINDING.name: Potion of Binding
POTION_OF_BINDING.zh_description: 对全体敌人施加 1 层 Weak 与 1 层 Vulnerable。

POTION_SHAPED_ROCK.description: Combat-use: dealt 15 damage to the target live (run-51 vs KnowledgeDemon). Procured at combat start by Petrified Toad. Not a heal.
POTION_SHAPED_ROCK.name: Potion-Shaped Rock

POT_OF_GHOULS.name: Pot of Ghouls
POT_OF_GHOULS.zh_description: 向手牌加入 2 张 Soul。

POWDERED_DEMISE.description: apply DemisePower 9 to the target — the target takes 9 unblockable, unpowered damage at the end of each of its turns. Run-41 live: killed a 4-HP Exoskeleton end-of-turn after it had already attacked; a kill-timer potion for escape-clock and HP-wall fights, not a block tool.
POWDERED_DEMISE.name: Powdered Demise
POWDERED_DEMISE.zh_description: 施加 DemisePower 9——目标每个自身回合结束时受到 9 点不可格挡、无来源伤害。

POWER_POTION.description: Opens a choose-one-power card_choice overlay (live run-52 options: DEMON_FORM / STONE_ARMOR / STAMPEDE). The chosen power is GENERATED AS A 0-COST CARD INTO HAND — it must then be played like any card; it is not auto-applied. STAMPEDE picked run-52 = 0-cost card that applied STAMPEDE_POWER:1 (auto-play Amount attack cards from hand at end of post-play phase).
POWER_POTION.name: Power Potion
POWER_POTION.zh_description: 打开三选一能力 card_choice 覆盖层（live run-52 选项：DEMON_FORM / STONE_ARMOR / STAMPEDE）。选中的能力**以 0 费卡形式生成进手牌**——须像普通卡一样打出，不会自动生效。run-52 选 STAMPEDE = 0 费卡打出后获得 STAMPEDE_POWER:1（自动后打出阶段从手牌自动打出 Amount 张攻击牌）。

RADIANT_TINCTURE.description: gain 1 Energy now; apply RadiancePower 3 — +1 Energy on each of your next 3 energy resets.
RADIANT_TINCTURE.name: Radiant Tincture
RADIANT_TINCTURE.zh_description: 立即获得 1 能量；获得 RadiancePower 3——接下来 3 次能量重置时各 +1 能量。

REGEN_POTION.description: Gain 5 Regen on use (heal 5 at start of each of your turns, stacks decrement). Uncommon. LIVE run-40 died holding it; LIVE run-48 spent it correctly DURING the wall fight (HunterKiller T1 at 15 HP — rail ran 15→19→23→26-class across 4 ticks then expired mid-fight). Doctrine: HP-rail potions are for the attrition fight itself, not the rest site after — run-48's rest site was 2 rooms past the death point.
REGEN_POTION.name: Regen Potion
REGEN_POTION.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: spent mid-HunterKiller at 15 HP; rail ran ~4 ticks then expired in-fight. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]
REGEN_POTION.source: md:potions.md:L63; md:potions_zh.md:L63; codex:potions/REGEN_POTION; run-40 live fold 2026-09-18

SHACKLING_POTION.description: apply ShacklingPotionPower 7 to ALL enemies - temporary -7 Strength, lost at end of their turn. Seen in both run-43 shops (99g Act1-tail / 95g Act2 (5,0)); potion slots were full or gold spent on relics - not bought. Boss-gate class: cuts every multi-hit intent by 7 per hit.
SHACKLING_POTION.name: Shackling Potion
SHACKLING_POTION.zh_description: 对全体敌人施加 ShacklingPotionPower 7——临时 −7 力量，其回合结束时失去。

SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: gain 10 Block; apply BlockNextTurnPower 10 — the first time your Block is cleared, gain 10 Block again (once).
SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Ship in a Bottle
SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.zh_description: 获得 10 格挡；获得 BlockNextTurnPower 10——你的格挡首次被清除时再次获得 10 格挡（仅一次）。

SKILL_POTION.description: Opens a choose-one-skill card_choice overlay (live run-52 options: BATTLE_TRANCE / STOKE / EVIL_EYE). Like Power Potion, the chosen skill is generated as a 0-cost card into hand and must be played. EVIL_EYE live-lookup note: 8 Block, doubles to 16 only if another card was Exhausted earlier the same turn.
SKILL_POTION.name: Skill Potion
SKILL_POTION.play_notes: Run-54 live options observed (2026-09-19): Bygone Effigy fight offered HAVOC / BLOODLETTING / BURNING_PACT; earlier fight same run offered BATTLE_TRANCE-class set. Bloodletting generated as 0-cost = net +2 Energy that turn (combo enabler); True Grit copy (earlier run) = 7 block + random hand exhaust (run-53 note applies).
SKILL_POTION.zh_description: 打开三选一技能 card_choice 覆盖层（live run-52 选项：BATTLE_TRANCE / STOKE / EVIL_EYE）。与能力药水相同，选中技能以 0 费卡生成进手牌、须自行打出。EVIL_EYE lookup 备注：8 格挡，仅当同回合此前已消耗过其他牌时翻倍至 16。

SNECKO_OIL.description: draw 7; randomize the cost of every non-X card currently in your hand.
SNECKO_OIL.name: Snecko Oil
SNECKO_OIL.zh_description: 抽 7 张；随机化手牌中所有非 X 费卡牌的费用。

SOLDIER_STEW.description: All cards containing Strike gain 1 Replay this combat.
SOLDIER_STEW.name: Soldier's Stew

SOLDIER_S_STEW.description: every card with the Strike tag in your combat piles gains +1 Replay for this combat. The Replay behaves as a one-shot charge per card at use-time — strikes already in hand/draw when the potion is drunk replay once when played; strikes drawn later in the same combat resolve a single time.
SOLDIER_S_STEW.name: Soldier's Stew
SOLDIER_S_STEW.zh_description: 本场战斗内你战斗牌堆中所有含 Strike 标签的卡牌 +1 次 Replay。Replay 表现为用药时对各张卡的一次性充能 —— 用药时已在手牌/抽牌堆中的打击牌打出时额外结算一次；战斗后期才抽到的打击只结算一次。

SPEED_POTION.description: apply +5 Dexterity for the current turn only; lose it end of turn. One-turn burst block - spend on the turn the lethal intent lands, not earlier. Live run-43 Act1 Boss T10: Dex 1->6 under Speed, but hand had no block cards so the burst went unused that turn (planned for SCREAM 13; Beckon tax hit instead). Lesson: Speed Potion pays only when block CARDS are in hand to amplify.
SPEED_POTION.name: Speed Potion
SPEED_POTION.play_notes: Run-49 negative live: drawn vs Spiny Toad SPIKE_EXPLOSION 23 with a zero-block hand — potion unspendable (no block cards to amplify). Run-43 lesson repeated verbatim: Speed Potion pays only when block CARDS are in hand.
SPEED_POTION.zh_description: 获得 SpeedPotionPower +5 敏捷——本回合结束时失去 5 敏捷（临时敏捷）。

STABLE.description: Stable Serum: Retain your Hand for 2 turns (cards stay in hand end of turn). Uncommon. LIVE run-40: held as belt reserve through Act2; retain does not add block — not a lethal-intent answer by itself.
STABLE.name: Stable Serum

STABLE_SERUM.description: apply RetainHandPower 2 — your hand is not flushed at end of turn for the next 2 turns.
STABLE_SERUM.name: Stable Serum
STABLE_SERUM.zh_description: 获得 RetainHandPower 2——接下来 2 个回合结束时不弃手牌。

SWIFT_POTION.description: Draw 3 cards. Boss-reward roll run-43; spent T1 of the Act2 (1,1) Bowlbug fight digging for block to reach IMBALANCED stun threshold - drew attacks instead (Pommel/TwinStrike/Strike), stun line missed that turn.
SWIFT_POTION.name: Swift Potion

TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.description: Choose 1 hand card that costs Energy or stars; it costs 0 for the rest of combat. Usage: hand_select overlay choose(index) THEN proceed. Live run-42 BygoneEffigy: Bash made 0-cost rest of combat — free Bash+Vuln every draw for the kill window.
TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.name: Touch of Insanity
TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.zh_description: 选择手牌中 1 张消耗能量或星星的卡牌；本场战斗其费用为 0。

WEAK_POTION.description: Apply 3 Weak to the target (attacks -25% for 3 turns). Live run-43 Act1 Boss SoulFysh T7: DE_GAS intent 24->18 on a player-Vuln turn - the 6-point cut plus 6 block turned a 24-leak into 12. Boss-gate reserve doctrine: spend on the highest live intent, keep a heal-class potion behind it.
WEAK_POTION.name: Weak Potion
